items.title: Gate Codex permission, sandbox, approval, and exec-policy compatibility
items.summary: Codex changed permission/path conversion plus sandbox, approval, exec-policy, and MCP-facing surfaces that the ctrl profile explicitly classifies as a blocking policy boundary.
items.localContractImpact: Do not silently adopt the changed behavior in spec/.codex or TDD policy configuration until local executable compatibility validation is available.

observations.observation: Since c4941302c73c6322b153bba13ac0a9f4396301d6, Codex changed permission/sandbox/approval/exec-policy surfaces. The v2 file-system permission projection now uses Path URI conversion and only emits legacy read/write roots when richer entries are legacy-compatible.

claims.text: The changed Codex policy boundary reaches declared spec/.codex and TDD consumers and requires compatibility evidence before local adoption.

items.title: Update Codex app-server protocol and schema assumptions
items.summary: Codex app-server protocol and generated JSON/config schemas changed together, including new project and strict-review notifications and thread/MCP schema changes.
items.localContractImpact: Review ctrl Codex request/notification and generated-schema assumptions under spec/.codex and integrations/openai against the new exact source revision.

observations.observation: Between c4941302c73c6322b153bba13ac0a9f4396301d6 and 76ceaddb29444388fbbbae07c46f7e8849f9658b, protocol sources and exported JSON/config schemas changed; StrictReviewRequiredNotification, ProjectChangedNotification and ThreadProjectUpdatedNotification were added.

claims.text: The declared codex-rust-protocol -> codex-json-schema projection has changed and local protocol/schema consumers must be reconciled against the new projection.

items.title: Preserve CPython regrtest environment-change reasons as behavioral evidence
items.summary: CPython regrtest now retains per-test environment-change reasons and renders them individually; this changes the behavioral evidence available to local regrtest normalization.
items.localContractImpact: The qualification-workflow regrtest adapter/normalizer must preserve or explicitly discard the new environment-change reason dimension; an upstream regrtest result still does not self-authorize qualification.

observations.observation: Compared with the prior 3.14 baseline, TestResults now records env_changed_reasons from TestResult and displays each reason beneath the affected test.
CPython main independently advanced across the same monitored regrtest family and remains forecast evidence distinct from the 3.14 active baseline.

claims.text: The upstream behavioral oracle now exposes more structured environment-change evidence; ctrl must treat it as evidence input and not as a qualification verdict.

items.localContractImpact: Keep as forecast evidence for static/dynamic correlation and future probe selection; no runtime or qualification conclusion is admitted.

claims.text: Astral changes are analyzer observations only and require CPython/probe correlation before any semantic or qualification claim.

items.title: Track breaking OTel-Arrow dataflow internal telemetry changes
items.summary: OTel-Arrow changed OTAP receiver/exporter internal metric names and bounded attribute dimensions under rust/otap-dataflow, while the profile's semantic OTAP node remains tied to docs/otap-spec.md and docs/data_model.md.
items.localContractImpact: Treat as dataflow implementation evidence. Do not promote it to an OTLP/OTAP semantic-preservation contract change without a change on the declared OTAP semantic node.

observations.observation: The dataflow receiver/exporter telemetry now uses bounded signal/outcome/error.type dimensions, renamed receiver.otap.* and exporter.otap.* metrics, and fixed-memory timing aggregation; upstream marks the metric change breaking.

claims.text: This interval changes the optional dataflow implementation surface, not the declared OTAP semantic model used by the traces-only preservation witness.

items.title: Track dlt forward-only incremental cursor fix
items.summary: dlt now treats persisted incremental last_value == 0 as present when lag is configured, preserving forward-only cursor progression.
items.localContractImpact: Retain as external-observation acquisition correctness evidence; acquired records remain subject to provenance and admission before fact status.

observations.observation: The incremental lag guard changed from truthiness to an explicit is-not-None check so a persisted zero cursor cannot cause a rewind on the next run.

claims.text: The fix improves acquisition-state correctness but does not authorize acquired records as ctrl facts or qualification evidence by itself.
